svg.title: Eventiva layer 2, group 1
svg.desc: Prerequisite arrows point toward dependent issues. Layers are derived, not approved dates. Labels and border patterns distinguish completed, current, upcoming, closed and blocked work. Every node links to its live issue; Markdown provides full titles, prerequisites and unlocks.
svg.text: Derived layers; not deadlines or acceptance.
Blocked overrides fill/border; current keeps double.

a.aria-label: EVE-68: F4.1 Build people, organisations and contact points as CRM actions. UPCOMING / BLOCKED. Captured Linear: Backlog. 2026-11-18T14:15:22.812Z: later-status: Owner-relayed revision-4 packet and clarification select a bounded tenant-private organisation backend using six public host actions, paired Resources/stable UUIDv7 and default-off crm.enabled. Ten focused tests pass, including eight real PostgreSQL/SQLite scenarios with rollback, revision races, isolation, paging, reconnect, revocation and safe telemetry. Rebased sequential-batch main 21438ec0 preserves product/UUID and portable-client delivery, passing root check, all 104 aggregate and 17 smoke/dependency tasks; standalone documentation and ratchet report zero findings/violations across 259 files. Exact UUID normalization is included, but provider discovery remains incomplete: bounded names and composed minima remain independent refusals. Shared compiler stays read-only in this lane and runtime schemas stay strict. Signed delivery and remote CI are recorded separately; Person/contacts, team/private policy, UI/offline/native/HTTP/MCP parity and whole EVE-68 remain open. Frozen capture is unchanged; EVE-248 stays deferred to January 2027, with no spend or production activation. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-68#comment-1fb5f620-046e-4144-8f24-64e20c3ca4a3, https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-68#comment-3601c5f9-a453-4a11-be9a-d3447fbe8ef3, https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-68#comment-ca2f3188-82eb-49a1-92c8-cd4105fdb0ba, https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-68#comment-51e7e3a9-f92f-4bc7-95ac-5a1057a3c941, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1e940-37a3-7691-a5c0-e935b711c99a. 4 prerequisites; 5 unlocks. Layer 2.
